description: Per-run learning curves of the BMD design-criterion arms (C4) and feedback variants (C3) on the four benchmarks, keyed by dataset, arm and task|seed; x = observation count. The 'forcebench_full' datasets are the full-interface ForceBench runs (shift = six shifted designs, headline = the benchmark's three designs); 'forcebench_masked' are the earlier masked-interface runs; 'c4_newtonbench_joint_all27' holds all 27 joint-criterion runs, of which the 26 with every other arm complete form 'c4_newtonbench'.
